allow: PowerShell($g = Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { "gh: $\($g.Source\)"; gh --version; gh auth status } else { "gh: NOT FOUND" })
PowerShell($v = Get-Command vpk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($v\) { "vpk: $\($v.Source\)"; vpk --version } else { "vpk: NOT FOUND on PATH" })

PowerShell($g = Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { "git: $\($g.Source\)"; git --version } else { "git: NOT FOUND" }; "--- tokens in env ---"; Get-ChildItem env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'GH_|GITHUB|VPK_TOKEN' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }; "--- gh config ---"; if \(Test-Path "$env:APPDATA\\GitHub CLI\\hosts.yml"\) { "gh hosts.yml EXISTS" } else { "no gh config" })
